messages:
ana: FYI: post-rotation in eu-west we got a spike of TLS handshake failures from services in us-east starting 02:12 UTC. users reported 502s at the edge.

rashid: can you paste the error from the edge proxy logs?

ana: ```
[2026-04-04T02:12:09Z] envoy ERROR TLS handshake failed: no certificates available for SNI 'api.us-east.redwood.ai'
[2026-04-04T02:12:09Z] envoy ERROR xds: certificate not found for cert-id=keystore/eu-west/20260404/v2
```

terry: sounds like the keystore version reference is present but replicas don't have the blob. when we rotated we relied on S3 CRR to propagate encrypted keystore objects across regions.

ops-oncall: checking S3 replication status. replication reports success but there are object-level errors around 02:10: ``Replica failed: KMSDecryptFailed`` for key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:alias/keystore-key.

ana: that would make the replicated object unreadable by the us-east consumers. was a new KMS key created during the rotation?

rashid: yes — rotation script created a new key in eu-west and updated key policy to allow the rotation role. but the replication role (s3-replication-role@org) needs kms:Decrypt on the source CMK to replicate encrypted object ciphertext to the replica region and rewrap it. looks like the role was not added.

infra-ci: pipeline log snippet: ```
> aws kms create-key --description "keystore-rotation-eu-west-20260404"
> aws kms put-key-policy --key-id alias/keystore-key --policy file://keypolicy.json
# keypolicy.json currently grants: Principal: rotation-role, Action: [Encrypt,ReEncryptTo,ReEncryptFrom,GenerateDataKey] 
# missing: Principal: s3-replication-role kms:Decrypt permission
```

terry: why did S3 replication claim success? looks like S3 marks replication completed once copy-to-replica bucket finished at metadata level, even if replication encryption transform fails. need to check replication-reports and CloudTrail.

ops-oncall: CloudTrail shows PutObject for the replica-bucket at 02:09 then KMS API calls show DecryptDenied for the s3-replication-role when attempting to decrypt the source object's EDK at 02:09:10Z.

ana: so chain: rotation created new CMK; replication role lacks Decrypt on that CMK -> replicated object exists but ciphertext not re-encrypted for us-east -> keystore loader in us-east can't Decrypt -> no certs loaded -> handshake failures.

rashid: immediate mitigations: (A) add kms:Decrypt to replication role key policy (fast but expands key access), (B) revert to previous keystore version and key (safer), (C) copy and rewrap objects server-side using an account that can assume appropriate role. which is least risky?

terry: revert to previous keystore is safest for immediate service recovery. apply keypolicy change after rollback as part of controlled rotation.

deploy-bot: rolling keystore rollback: keystore-roll-20260404 by terry 1/3

ops-oncall: rollback complete at 02:28 UTC. us-east cert loader reported keystore v1 active and handshakes recovered.

ana: good. post-incident tasks: we still have an audit gap: we expected replication errors to generate CloudTrail/Config alerts. why didn't our alerting trigger?

rashid: investigated: CloudTrail logged the KMS DecryptDenied events, but our AlertRule 'kms-access-deny-surge' filters on EventSource = kms.amazonaws.com AND EventName = Decrypt. DecryptDenied appears under ReEncrypt* calls from S3 (ReEncryptFrom) so it didn't match.

ops-oncall: additionally, our central log shipper dropped ~40 CloudTrail events in the 02:05-02:15 window due to a transient ingestion backlog. that's why the alert didn't page. backlog root cause is unrelated (ELB of log-forwarder hit 5xx at same time).

sec-bot: incident created INC-20260404-2 by ana. priority=P1. linked playbook: keystore-replication-failure-v2

terry: proposed action items: 
- update key rotation template to always include s3-replication-role with kms:Decrypt in the CMK policy OR require rotation to use an assume-role model for replication (owner: infra).
- expand alert rule to match ReEncryptFrom/ReEncryptTo and Decrypt events across sources (owner: security).
- add an integration test in CI that runs a mock rotation and validates cross-region keystore load (owner: devex).
- add hardened retries/visibility in S3 replication reports and mark objects with replication status tags (owner: storage).
- investigate log-forwarder 5xx and increase CloudTrail ingest redundancy (owner: eng-infra).

rashid: i'll open PRs for keypolicy template and the alert rule. here's a minimal KMS policy snippet to add to the rotation automation: ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"AllowReplicationRoleDecrypt","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/s3-replication-role"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:ReEncryptFrom"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```

ana: also adding a short runbook for oncall: how to detect replication KMS denies, quick rollback steps, and how to safely regrant replication role permissions with justification. will attach to the incident.

ops-oncall: alerts updated: now trigger on EventName in [Decrypt,ReEncryptFrom,ReEncryptTo] and include S3 PutObject followed by KMS Deny patterns. added temporary escalation threshold lower for next 24h.

terry: schedule a dry-run next week for eu-west rotation with canary replication check in us-east. include a smoke test that loads keystore and performs openssl s_client handshake.

ana: thanks team. monitoring healthy for now. re-open if anything flares. :white_check_mark:
